hooks.command: test -n "$(git status --porcelain -- src/)" && printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"src/ changed — applying the repo review checklist from docs/agents/reviewing.md before this commit.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"This commit touches src/. Before treating it as done, read docs/agents/reviewing.md and apply both parts of its checklist to the diff — Part 1 (guideline compliance, mapping the diff against every row of the AGENTS.md routing table) and Part 2 (deviation control). That file is the single source of truth for the checklist items; work from what it says, not from memory of it. Then scan docs/agents/remarks.md for the sections matching what the diff touches and report any R-NNN the diff would earn. Report findings in the reporting format reviewing.md defines, most-severe-first, and state no findings explicitly when clean."}}' || true
